semiconductor_relevance: High — Holding Electric Co., Ltd. specializes in equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as backgrind, slicing, lapping, and polishing.
summary: Holding Electric Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures advanced equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on precision and quality. With over 120 patents, the company is committed to innovation and delivering high-quality products tailored for semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company manufactures its products in Taiwan, emphasizing local technology and quality control.
